name: ScarabMounted
identity: Dark olive orange-eyed beetle with six long cream jointed legs, ivory mandibles and brown leather saddle on its back. No rider.

reference_review.method: Actually viewed original 1024x512 atlas and full source and battle prefab renders; read serialized source and battle structures.
reference_review.observed_identity: Dark olive oval segmented beetle with ochre spots, two long dark banded antennae attached to the head, two orange lens eyes, pale-gold curved mandibles, six long cream jointed legs with ochre pointed tips, tan leather saddle with raised rear cantle; no rider, wings, tail or independent feelers.
reference_review.source_bindings: Body and all six legs use ScarabMounted atlas 61c99d3081db09a40a7cb3ef485b597a. Battle Head uses original Scarab atlas 306903ba18c180f46ac3783156892cb4; preserve original PPtr bindings and events. Do not repair this pre-existing shared-head binding as part of the direction art task.
reference_review.up_anatomy: Rear head plate and backs of both antennae, no orange eyes or mouth/mandible front details; closed spotted back with one saddle, six rear-oriented pointed legs.
reference_review.down_anatomy: Centered paired orange eyes and two long antennae integrated into all three detached head states, pale-gold paired mandibles, torso with one saddle only, three mirrored pairs of cream legs.
reference_review.excluded: No rider, tail, wings, extra heads, extra legs, duplicated saddle or ground shadow.
